2400.ed: People say this bubble tea shop offers delicious and creamy brown sugar boba milk tea with flavorful, chewy, and warm pearls. They also highlight the fast service and friendly staff. Some reviews mention the drinks can be overpriced.

rv.t: ​🌟 A Masterclass in Caramelized Perfection: Xing Fu Tang 🧋✨ ​As someone who frequently explores complex gastronomy and meticulously analyzes culinary flavor profiles 🧐🍽️, my standards for artisanal beverages are uncompromising 💯. Xing Fu Tang does not just meet these expectations; it completely redefines them! 🎉🏆 ​This is not merely a cup of bubble tea 🧋—it is a beautifully orchestrated culinary experience 🎭🤤. The…

It’s a very good bubble tea restaurant famous for its brown sugar boba milk. It may not be the best branch there is but it’s still good. There are no chairs to sit on so you can drink it while walking around. Overall I would recommend stopping by to try bubble tea in Taiwan and this is a great place to do so.

First milk tea I have ever tasted the milk. Ordered the number 1 item (signature brown sugar) and it was amazing. Just right sweetness that makes it a delight to drink and the boba has a great chewiness to it.

2401.aj: 224 台湾 New Taipei City, Ruifang District, Chongwen Village, Jishan St, 112號 金枝紅糟肉円（総店） Taiwanese Meatballs —Jiufen
2401.ed: Diners like this eatery's red yeast rice ba-wan for its unique flavor and chewy skin, and many also enjoy the flavorful and varied assorted meatball soup. Other reviews mention the ba wan can be cold and the service can be inefficient.

rv.t: Ordered the giant red meatball and the assorted ball soup. The giant red meatball’s outer texture was great as it was chewy and was satisfying to work your way through to the fillings. The cilantro gave an enjoyable contrast. However the red sauce was unusual for my tastes and a bit off putting of the whole experience. The flavor reminded me of herbal Chinese medicine that your Taiwanese mother might boil for you as…
The best meatballs in town , very umami , wishing to have that at the rest of places around Taiwan. The cucumber pickles are perfect for the summer.

It was the red wine marinate that caught my attention. The fragrance of the Chinese red wine is present but I am used to much stronger Chinese red wine, it is a little mild for me while i do an appreciate its flavour. Perhaps I linked it with the red wine chicken that I am familiar with so expectations were a little different. Objectively, it is beautifully done with the skin thin and stretchy. Meat filling is well…

2402.aj: 幸福堂九彬第一家 最佳観景区（175号） No. 175號, Jishan St, Chongwen Village, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, 台湾 224

rv.t: Bubble tea place located in juifen. It's fairly fast, and you if don't speak Mandarin, you can easily point to what you want to order. Boba tasted sweet and were perfectly chewy, you can also see what them brew the pearls in this giant vat which was cool. We ordered the matcha milk tea and it was great. Worth it considering the location. Get your Boba and enjoy the view.

We ordered the brown sugar milk tea. It indicates the sweet and ice level both cannot be adjusted. Only the brown sugar pearl has sugar and not in the tea and milk. As they made the pearl fresh and they are still warm, the fixed ice level is required to bring the hot pearl to a cold drink. As the pearl is quite hot, it really needed that standard level of ice to bring the drink to a cold drink. It’s not cold cold -…

I tried the Brown Sugar Boba Milk, and it’s definitely a treat! It might look super sweet, but once you take a sip, the milk and brown sugar blend perfectly for a great balance of flavors. Highly recommend giving it a try! There was no queue even though I went on a weekend so I got my drink quickly.

2403.ed: Iconic tea house in a former blacksmith shop, with tea ceremonies & terrace views.
2403.edj: 元は鍛冶屋だった象徴的な喫茶店。茶芸とテラスからの景色を楽しめる。

rv.t: My 3rd time at this tea house. Located in the popular jiufen mountain it’s a wonderful tea house that has great views of the mountain side. The experience is very fun as they teach you how to brew tea like a local Taiwanese. We got the cold oolong which comes already brewed and a Jasmine tea. Both had beautiful scents and for the hot teas the more times you brew it the stronger it gets. The service is fast and very…

I finally visited A-Mei Tea House, following in the footsteps of Spirited Away. I ordered the tea set which comes with four types of traditional snacks for NT$350 per person. The snacks were delicious—not too sweet and paired perfectly with the tea. The highlight, however, was the 'million-dollar view.' I was lucky enough to get a corner seat on the 3rd floor, and the scenery was breathtaking. With the cool winter…

This place offer a breathtaking view but the tea here is very expensive compared to other shops in Taiwan. They'll only give you a very small amount of snacks for your tea, but the tea will be unlimited. If you enjoy tea this place would be great for you.

2404.aj: 九份老街 Jishan St, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, 台湾 224
catj: ヘリテージビルディング
2404.ed: Bustling district known for its narrow streets, food stalls & sweeping views of the mountains & sea.
2404.edj: 小さな路地と屋台で知られる、賑やかなエリア。山と海を一望できる。

rv.t: Jiufen Old Street is a beautiful place with a unique atmosphere and amazing views. I visited as part of a one-day tour, so unfortunately I didn’t have enough time to fully explore everything. I really think this is a place where you could easily spend a whole day, wandering through all the charming shops, trying the local food, and enjoying the stunning ocean views. I hope to come back someday with more time to…

Busy. Friendly. A lot of Up/down hills/stairs during raining day was chilled. Some stairs are steep. Cars are able to drive on the walking street. Beautiful decorations with red lanterns, most of the shops are open 10-11 am. Some gift/souvenirs shops open around 9am. Plenty of premade/handmade desserts, bakeries. Many food vendors have similar menus. Coffee shops, Tea/Leather/Fashion goods. Some food shops offered…

A fantastic place to explore and shop! There are plenty of souvenirs, snacks, local foods, and unique items to browse. Every corner is photogenic, making it a great spot for taking pictures. The whole area has the charm of a quaint little village, with a unique atmosphere that makes it enjoyable to stroll around and discover new things. Definitely worth a visit!

2405.a: 224, Taiwan, New Taipei City, Ruifang District, Chongwen Village, Shuqi Rd, 5號九份阿牧包子(A-MU buns)
2405.aj: 224 台湾 New Taipei City, Ruifang District, Chongwen Village, Shuqi Rd, 5號 九彬阿牧包子

rv.t: To all tourists, considering the *price and quality* of the steamed dumplings, I’d recommend trying Din Tai Fung instead if you want to try the real good stuff during your time in Taiwan. With this quality, it’s only worth under NT$100. They charge NT$200 simply because it’s located in Jiufen.

Good freshly made taste with simple and natural ingredients. Not many choices for food but all are good, with some vegetarian options which are sweet. Soy milk also refreshing to combine with buns. The meat bun with pickled veggies tasted better to me, slightly spicy. Ask for spicy sauce if desired. A slight climb but nice sitting environment to rest and enjoy away from the bigger crowds.

Small atmospheric restaurant at the top of old street with delicious and fresh soup dumplings 🤩 These are the best soup dumplings we have had while in Taiwan! It is impressive that they can fit so much soup inside them! We found out that the trick is to freeze the soup beforehand, which now seems kinda obvious 🤔

2406.ed: Diners like this noodle shop's delicious beef noodle soup, noting its tender beef and flavorful, often herbal, broth, as well as the tasty wontons and dried noodles. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, and the reasonable prices. Some reviews mention the seating can be cramped.

rv.t: Small family restaurant serving delicious noodles. They are famous for beef noodles soup and wonton noodles. You can also get dry noodles if you don’t want soup. Also recommend the tripe and braised pork belly rice. Tasty!
Very tasty beef noodle. Better than most beef noodle places in Taipei. I finished too fast, so only have this picture...

Delicious handmade noodles and Jiufen-style broth. If you want to dine, make sure you reserve your order or spot early with the shop owner or you might get stuck in the long line during lunch rush time. The seating area are limited but is enough for you to enjoy the savory noodles. Tourist price affected the portion, but still acceptable since it's the only good beef noodle spot in the Old Street path. Will come…

2407.ed: Swanky suites with quirky lounges in a hillside property offering free breakfast & scenic views.

rv.t: Absolutely fantastic. I can't recommend it enough. Worth every penny. Yes, the room, the view, and the porch are all extraordinary. It's just like the photos and super comfortable. The location is also superb. It's right at the tail end of the old street from the bus stops. Do be sure to ask them for help with the luggage, because otherwise it's a bit of a trek down some stairs. Given that it's on a relatively steep…

Amazing view from our room! Even when it's cloudy and foggy, when the sky clears it is beautiful. Staff was great, they helped bring our stuff up our room. Breakfast was included with a bento box of sandwich. The b&b is a 3 minute walk from the main busy alley but far enough that the location is quiet and peaceful. Very very comfortable beds, we slept really well after a long day of walking. Hot shower was adequate…

The View. Spectacular with clever room planning so you can enjoy both from inside the room and from the terrace/balcony. At the edge of Old street. Clean, quiet, comfortable with A/C. Charming bathroom, spacious, clean. Nice morning breakfast brought to room. This way could enjoy Jiufen/old street before / after rushes since staying the night. Would Recommend.

2408.aj: A GAN YI TARO BALL, No. 5號, Shuqi Rd, Fuzhu Village, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, 台湾 22448

2408.ed: People say this dessert shop offers delicious, chewy taro balls with rich, natural flavors, available hot or cold with various beans. They also highlight the stunning mountain and ocean views from the spacious seating area, clean restrooms, and reasonable prices. Some reviews mention the ice can be coarse.

rv.t: The concept of eating beans as a sweet option is completely new to me. It was a great experience, but it isn’t my type of food haha You should try though! Going to Taiwan and not eating taro balls or drinking bubble tea is impossible! I bought it to go cause I was late to get the bus, but the service is awesome! Very fast
This is a shop in Jiufen where you can enjoy taro desserts. After picking up your taro dessert, head to the back of the shop. You can enjoy your treat while looking out over the ocean.

I can't even imagine how many bowls of taro balls the boss sells everyday. And there's a reason for that. You can get a ball in 30 seconds because he's so efficient. And there's amazing seating. Be polite. Order your balls and go watch the view. When you're done, move on to the next person can enjoy as well. I did the iced version but I believe the hot version would be delicious as well. Foreigners don't be afraid…

2409.ed: Diners like this eatery's delicious Fuzhou fish balls, which are praised for their thin skin and juicy filling, as well as the flavorful braised pork rice and chewy dry noodles. They also highlight the fast service, reasonable prices for a tourist area, and the staff's excellent foreign language skills. Some reviews mention the service can be impolite.

rv.t: They close later than some others and is a gd option after 7pm. Say hello and they will seat you. Then you order and pay first, and wait for them to serve your order. Be prepared to share tables when they're busy. I had the mixed balls - fuzhou fish ball (with minced meat stuffing) was the best of the 3 types. You can give the soup a miss - i feel like the purpose of the soup is just to cook the balls. Heh. Also had…
The fish ball is firm and chewy. Taste fresh full of flavour. The pork rice box is on point typical Taiwan flavour.

I wolfed down my bowl in no time. It was really tasty. Only thing I would change is to order the Fuzhou fish balls specifically (NOT the mixed balls that have the thumbs up). The mixed one has 2 Fuzhou fish balls, 1 squid ball and 1 meat ball but the fish balls really are the best. I arrived at 11am on a Sunday and store was 75% full but food is served real quick and crowd shuffles in and out quickly too.

rv.t: This station was surprisingly well equipped. There are toilet facilities, fare top ups, lockers for bags, hot water top up on the platform, signs in English as well. If you're going to Shifen it's platform 3. Staff are around to ask basic questions. Train to Shifen was well air-conditioned and comfortable. Train arrived about 15 minutes before departure. If you want a seat get to the platform early. It can be busy.

I like this station... It's a must go through station, stop if going by jiu fen 九份. It's interesting because it's very local and traditional. Hidden gem of coffee places. Not much sightseeing though. To go through the other end, you can just take a pass through ticket and return it once you are through the underpass. There's currently some construction around and looks like there's a new platform or train station…

I mean I like the environment but the counter personnel attitude is unacceptable. As a Malaysian that know Taiwan very well I don’t think Taiwanese are rude but he is ole of them. As a tourist sometimes we are confuse and when I ask he raise his voice as me to see by myself. Wow Taiwan. Very good

2411.a: Taiwan, New Taipei City, Pingxi District, 226 Shifen Station
2411.aj: 台湾 New Taipei City, Pingxi District, 226 十分駅
2411.ed: People say this train station offers a unique experience with train tracks running through the street, allowing visitors to release sky lanterns and take memorable photos. They also highlight the lively atmosphere with many shops and food stalls, and appreciate the accessible facilities for wheelchair users. Some reviews mention the service can be inefficient.

rv.t: I visited the Shifen Station and it was one of the most memorable stops on my trip. The place has a very nostalgic and charming atmosphere, especially because the train tracks run right through the middle of the street, which is something you do not see every day. The main highlight here is releasing sky lanterns. You can write your wishes on the lantern and then release it onto the tracks before it floats up into…

Lovely little station with reasonable set up for departure and arrival passengers not to overlap each other for entering and exiting exiting. There is machine and staff taking order for tickets with various payment including credit card. Public washroom nearby

This station is a histroical train station tucked away in Taipei, perfect for snapping some cool photos along the railway tracks. The nostalgic vibe makes it feel like you’ve stepped into some old movies' scene. but be careful! Watch your steps while chasing that perfect shot, because trains still pass through!

2412.a: Smoothie House, No. 15號, Yongkang St, 大安區 Da’an District, Taipei City, Taiwan 106
2412.aj: Smoothie House, No. 15號, Yongkang St, 大安區 Da’an District, Taipei City, 台湾 106
catj: デザート ショップ
2412.ed: People say this shaved ice shop offers delicious and refreshing mango shaved ice with generous portions, and the staff provides quick and friendly service. Other reviews mention the mango can be tasteless and artificial, and seating can be limited and crowded.

rv.t: The smoothest shaved ice with soft and sweet mangoes, then top with a scoop of mango ice cream. Good size for two people to share. Just limited outside sitting area, so you have wait for your turn. We will come here every time we visit Taipei. Absolutely delicious.

Since mango is currently out of season (until June/July), they use frozen mango, which is clearly disclosed before ordering. Naturally, frozen mango can vary in quality in each order, and won’t always compare to fresh in-season fruit, which likely explains the mixed reviews. That said, the frozen mango in my bowl was still quite good; sweet, flavorful, and paired nicely with the mango milky ice, which was very…

Mango season runs from April to August. The mangoes being served now are frozen, but that doesn’t mean they lack flavor. If anything, they must have been flash-frozen at peak ripeness—the sweetness was more than enough. There are only three or four tables. Most people pick up their bowls of shaved ice and set them on the narrow ledge attached to the safety railing—a kind of standing bar table—eating right there on…

2413.ed: People say this hypermarket offers a wide variety of local snacks, souvenirs, and groceries, with many items available at reasonable prices. They also highlight its 24-hour operation and convenient location for tourists. Some reviews mention the service can be inefficient.

rv.t: This Carrefour superstore has almost everything I need in one place. On the second floor, they have electronics, computer, small and large appliances, apparel, shoes, luggage, bedding and kitchen essentials and everything you can find at a drug store and more. One the third floor, is huge supermarket with typical grocery items, and large selection of produce, meat, seafood, dairy, frozen food, bakery and prepared…

It wasn’t particularly close to the station, but the walk there made for a pleasant little stroll. The place somehow reminded me of a Lotte Mart in Yeongjongdo, Korea. A wide selection of food items was neatly displayed, many of them clearly intended as gifts that foreign visitors might take home. The prices didn’t seem overly expensive either. Although it was early in the morning and there were already quite a few…

A must-stop for tourists! This Carrefour Guilin is a one-stop shop for everything you need. They have a massive selection of local snacks and some of the freshest fruit I’ve found in the city. If you missed out on souvenir shopping they have a dedicated section for keychains and classic gifts. It’s close to Ximending and easily the most convenient, sheltered, and easy shopping experience.

2414.a: Tian Jin Onion Pancake, No. 1號, Lane 6, Yongkang St, Yongkang Village, Da’an District, Taipei City, Taiwan 106
2414.aj: Tian Jin Onion Pancake, No. 1號, Lane 6, Yongkang St, Yongkang Village, Da’an District, Taipei City, 台湾 106
2414.ed: Reviewers consistently praise this stall as a great value. Other reviews mention the staff can be impolite and the scallion pancakes can be bland.

rv.t: I came here with my daughter bc she loves scallion pancakes and had the worst experience. First, let’s talk about the hundreds of eggs kept in plastic crates in the corner of the shop unrefrigerated in the 90°F degree heat. One lady was cracking them into a giant container to use and she even used the cracked and slightly smashed ones. I was going to order #4 with ham and egg but changed my mind after seeing how the…

I ordered 2 scallion pancakes. One regular one with just eggs and the other with basil and cheese. I liked the first one better. One thing I would like to point out is that the spicy sauce which I put in the pancake was not spicy at all. Infact it had a little saltiness in it.

One of the best scallion pancakes in Taipei! If you come here, it is worth queueing up to at least try it once! 🤤🤤🤤 They are ran by 3 old cute ladies who work really hard. They are located at a corner of a small street cross junction in Yong Kang. Relatively near the train station. We came here on a Sunday afternoon at about 2.15pm and started queueing from around the corner. We only got to order at about 2.40pm and…

2415.a: Ay-Chung Flour-Rice Noodle, No. 8-1號, Emei St, Ximen Village, Wanhua District, Taipei City, Taiwan 108
2415.aj: 阿宗麺線 No. 8-1號, Emei St, Ximen Village, Wanhua District, Taipei City, 台湾 108
2415.ed: People say this noodle shop offers delicious flour-rice noodles in a rich, flavorful bonito broth with tender pork intestines. They also highlight the fast, efficient service and the convenient self-service condiment station for customizing flavors. Some reviews mention the large intestines can be chewy.

rv.t: This mee sua, or salted Chinese noodles made from wheat flour, tasted similar from my last visit here 11 years ago. The queue was still as long as back then, given that my visit here was a weekday mid afternoon. There were both locals and tourists and everyone was just standing around slurping and enjoying the hot soup. This, in my view, is the correct way to enjoy this bowl of mee sua. This, afterall, is Taipei so…

This place only sells one thing and they do it extremely well. I’ve not heard of this before nor had I had it before so I didn’t know what the original should taste like but we knew what good food tasted like and this was good! We walked past, saw a crowd, bought one and tried! There are condiments and sauces for you to add on at the side near the wall and also had tissue if you need them. A small hole in the wall…

Stopped by this morning. Ay Chung Flour -Rice Noodles,Located in Ximending Picked up the noodles a perfect match of noodles and soup stock. Make sure you stop by early because the queue is almost always 50 people or more the afternoon. A definite stop every time im in the area.also realize ther is no seating.

2416.a: 104, Taiwan, Taipei City, Zhongshan District, Jiying Village, Alley 3, Lane 45, Minsheng W Rd, 17號鴉片粥 一點創意麵線料理
2416.aj: 104 台湾 Taipei City, Zhongshan District, Jiying Village, Alley 3, Lane 45, Minsheng W Rd, 17號 第五家麵線·鴉片粥

rv.t: 5 stars for the great hospitality from the uncle seller. He could be a good salesperson, explaining to us everything and showed us the interview video by NHK Japan. Guess what, its free flow of congee. I order number 2 and 3 and extra big intestine. All are good to try. Damage: 275

The boss is very EMOTIONAL he likes to pretend deaf but also SHOUT to customers. And DONT BUY this food, it's NOT CLEAN. The SERVICE is truly very very BAD. I ordered No. 6 and said I will go to withdraw cash. The boss didn't say anything. When I came back, the boss didn't make my dish and didn't answer me anything. I asked him again and again, he just pretended deaf, I felt unrespected. He shouted to me and said I…

Had the set 1 and 2 which was the Porridge and Oyster Mee Sua. The owner of the stall was very friendly and accommodating! Awesome Taiwanese delicacy which was very authentic, heartwarming and yummylicious. Not much space to dine in as it primarily serves take out. Happened to stumble upon this place when I did a Google map search "Porridge near me".

2417.a: 100, Taiwan, Taipei City, Zhongzheng District, Liming Village, Qingdao W Rd, 13號青島飯糰
2417.aj: 100 台湾 Taipei City, Zhongzheng District, Liming Village, Qingdao W Rd, 13號青島飯糰
2417.ed: People say this rice ball stall offers delicious, filling rice balls with a wide variety of fresh ingredients, including purple or white rice at no extra cost. They also highlight the affordable prices, efficient service, and the staff's ability to communicate in Japanese. Some reviews mention the staff can be impolite.

rv.t: We got the purple rice original (the first one on the menu). It was delicious. The rice was nice and chewy. Lots of fillings inside but not so much that it was dry or it fell apart. It was flavourful and I regret not getting more. The wait was around 10-20 minutes as there were around 6 people in front of us and the lady makes them on the spot.

Every rice ball at Qingdao Rice Ball is packed with classic Taiwanese flavors. Most items are variations of the traditional pork floss rice ball (or vegetarian floss), with different add-ins such as scallion egg, braised egg, seaweed, bonito flakes, tuna, or corn. Prices are generally NT$40–55, making it affordable while still offering a generous portion. You can choose white rice or purple rice, and the best part…

First thing to note is you will definitely need some patience if you want to try this place. Lines are so large that it forms a snake around the street. I waited about 25 minutes for my rice ball. It is a family business where an elderly lady and someone who I presume is her son make the food, while the elderly man takes care of payment. I tried 3 different street stalls around our hotel for these rice balls and I…

2418.a: Chengzhong Market, No. 51-2號, Lane 22, Section 1, Wuchang St, Guangfu Village, Zhongzheng District, Taipei City, Taiwan 100
2418.aj: 城中市場 No. 51-2號, Lane 22, Section 1, Wuchang St, Guangfu Village, Zhongzheng District, Taipei City, 台湾 100
2418.ed: Colorful covered bazaar selling logo T-shirts, household goods & snacks like ba-wan dumplings.
2418.edj: 色鮮やかな屋内の市場。ロゴ入り T シャツ、日用品、肉圓などの軽食を売っている。

rv.t: Hidden gem only known to (old) locals. This unassuming market has cheap fruits, cheap clothing, and cheap food. The must try are the aiyu jelly with lemon, the squid soup, A-shun pork chop, and the 50 year old tofu dessert. ALL amazing. What a find.
This alley and its surrounding area offered different shopping experiences, most of the clothes were suitable for women 30's up. The payments here are cash only.
This place has such a great atmosphere, and I appreciate that it's off the beaten path - the local shops are really unique and worth exploring.

2419.a: 234, Taiwan, New Taipei City, Yonghe District, Heping Village, Section 1, Baofu Rd, 33號麵嫂
2419.aj: 234 台湾 New Taipei City, Yonghe District, Heping Village, Section 1, Baofu Rd, 33號麵嫂
2419.ed: Diners like this noodle shop's affordable and generous portions of wonton noodles, fresh meat side dishes, and friendly staff. Other reviews mention the noodles can be overcooked and service can be slow.

rv.t: This noodle stall has been a fixture in the area since long before I moved here years ago. I have witnessed its operation evolve through three generations—starting with the grandmother, then the mother, and now the son. Despite the changes in ownership over the years, the authentic flavour has remained untouched. The same traditional taste of deep-fried scallions serves as the soul of their noodles—simple yet…
I agree with one of the reviews, the food is rather tasteless. But the silver lining is less salt and MSG ;)

Traditional Taiwanese noodle place with the classic taste that’s hard to find nowadays. Amazing Wonton dry noodle! If you are expecting a clean and fresh setting you have a big misconception of what a traditional noodle place is like… especially one hidden away in the alleys of the night-market. The noodles however, is unbeatable.

2420.a: 100, Taiwan, Taipei City, Zhongzheng District, Longfu Village, Ningbo W St, 17號奇福扁食(南門寧波店)
2420.aj: 100 台湾 Taipei City, Zhongzheng District, Longfu Village, Ningbo W St, 17號奇福扁食(南門寧波店)
2420.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious wontons, especially the shrimp and scallop varieties, and the flavorful dry noodles with rich minced pork sauce. They also highlight the reasonable prices, clean environment, and friendly staff. Some reviews mention the portions can be small.

rv.t: Nice atmosphere, with clean tables, neat and spacious seating layout, and air conditioning. The noodles are chewy, thin and absolutely delicious, and with the fishball soup and cabbage to go along with it, this meal really delights your tongue. Staff are also very friendly even when we ordered food near to closing time. (They rest from 2.30pm to 4.30pm) Prices are very good average NT60 per dish.
Serve Taiwanese noodle (especially XO sauce noodle, recommended!) and wonton soup. Tasty and the price is inexpensive.
The food is not bad. I think noodles in Singapore are much better. The decor is a bit old but the surrounding stalls can be interesting.

2421.a: Yongkang Park, Yongkang St, Da’an District, Taipei City, Taiwan 106
2421.aj: 永康公園 Yongkang St, Da’an District, Taipei City, 台湾 106
2421.ed: Leafy gardens surrounded by tea houses & hip cafes selling filled pancakes, noodles & dumpling soup.
2421.edj: 緑豊かな公園。周囲には車輪焼き、麺料理、ワンタンスープなどを販売する茶館やおしゃれなカフェが立ち並ぶ。

rv.t: Nice little park to walk through and take a break. It feels calm and shady, which makes it a good spot to rest for a bit after walking around the area. Not very big, but the atmosphere is nice and peaceful.

Such a wonderful park. Great seating for everyone round the sides, wheelchair accessible. Flat park. A slide and some money bars for children to play on but not a lot - still the kids seems to love it. Surrounded by tea places which is great on a hot day. Although the greenery of the park does make the atmosphere feel cooler. A great escape from the concrete jungle.

⸻ I absolutely loved spending time at Yongkang Park—it’s such a charming little spot right in the middle of a lively area. Even though it’s not huge, it has such a cozy and welcoming vibe that makes you want to slow down and just enjoy the moment. The greenery is beautiful, and it’s the perfect place to take a break after exploring the busy streets nearby. I loved sitting and people-watching while soaking in the…

2422.a: Taiwanese donuts, No. 183, Huayin St, Jianming Village, Datong District, Taipei City, Taiwan 103
2422.aj: 脆皮鮮奶甜甜圈 No. 183, Huayin St, Jianming Village, Datong District, Taipei City, 台湾 103
2422.ed: Busy, unfussy food stand whipping up classic donuts & other sugary deep-fried treats.
2422.edj: 昔ながらのドーナツや甘い揚げ菓子を提供する、活気のあるシンプルな店。

rv.t: On my one visit, the line was super long and the wait felt even longer. From what I was able to observe, process and efficiency is a foreign concept. That said, if there is a line, and you are not near there front of the line, don’t expect your preferences to be available. The donuts are good. It’s donuts. Rarely are donuts not good. The type sold here is the traditional Taiwanese donut, stuffed. Choices of sweet or…

There are a wide variety of flavours, but apparently they only sell those at 3 time slots during the day. There was a short queue of people waiting for the donuts to be re-stocked. We had the Fresh cream (which was delicious) and Curry (ok). The donuts were not that crispy but still really good. The server wasnt very friendly. She stopped talking altogether when we tried to communicate in English.

Stumbled upon this place at the right time just before they were doing their fresh bakes at 2pm. Be prepared to queue in the hot sun as there is usually a winding stretch of people outside the shop. The original crispy donut was the bomb, tried the stuffed ones (奶油 and 巧克力), but they were not as good as the original.

2423.a: Park Lane by CMP, No. 68號, Gongyi Rd, Minlong Village, West District, Taichung City, Taiwan 403
2423.aj: 勤美誠品緑園道 No. 68號, Gongyi Rd, Minlong Village, West District, Taichung City, 台湾 403
catj: ショッピング モール
2423.ed: Sophisticated retail center offering 5 floors of brand-name shops, trendy boutiques & restaurants.
2423.edj: 洗練されたショッピング センター。5 つのフロアに有名ブランドのショップ、流行のブティック、レストランが入る。

rv.t: Is it worth the wait? Personally, the flavors are interesting but at the end of the day, it’s ice-cream, gelato, or sorbets. It’s good…. But it’s not *that* good. Recommend when the line is short for a quick in and out but if it gets long I’d say move on.

Located across from a large park and next to Intercontinental Hotel. This mall isn’t very big, but it does have a surprisingly spacious bookstore. It’s impressive to see so many books, especially in today’s digital age. They also sell vinyl records and turntables, which are quite rare to find in stores these days. There are several clothing shops, cosmetics, parfume (a lot of) and cute stationery stores. You’ll also…

Park Lane by CMP is a visually stunning space. The architecture seamlessly blends nature and urban design. The open-air layout creates a relaxed and inviting atmosphere. The variety of shops and restaurants caters to diverse tastes. From high-end fashion to local crafts, there's something for everyone. The dining options range from casual cafes to upscale restaurants. The green spaces provide a welcome respite from…

2424.a: Miyahara, No. 20號, Zhongshan Rd, Lüchuan Village, Central District, Taichung City, Taiwan 400
2424.aj: 宮原眼科 No. 20號, Zhongshan Rd, Lüchuan Village, Central District, Taichung City, 台湾 400
2424.ed: Popular ice cream parlor in an elegant historic building, offering specialty flavors & a restaurant.
2424.edj: レストランで特別な味が楽しめる、歴史ある上品な建物にある人気のアイスクリーム パーラー。

rv.t: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Must-Visit in Taichung! From the outside, the historic Miyahara building is incredibly striking, but stepping inside takes it to a whole new level. The interior feels beautifully luxurious, filled with grand wooden fixtures and towering shelves stocked with high quality teas, chocolates, and biscuits. it almost looks like a high-end library! A few key tips for your visit: Moon Pavilion Restaurant: There is a…

This place is unreal. Walking in feels like stepping into a Harry Potter library with 3-story tall wooden bookshelves, chandeliers, and a gorgeous skylight. It used to be a 1927 eye hospital but now it’s a stunning dessert shop + souvenir store. Came for the famous ice cream — 50+ flavors with free toppings like pineapple cake, nougat, and cheesecake. The salted egg yolk and brown sugar milk tea flavors are…

Miyahara is amazing! The ice cream is 超好吃 with so many flavors to choose from, and the building itself is beautiful — feels like stepping into a Harry Potter library. 很有特色的地方, perfect for desserts and photos. Highly recommended, will definitely come back!

2424.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2425.a: Rainbow Village, No. 25號春安路56巷 Chun'an Village, Nantun District, Taichung City, Taiwan 408
2425.aj: 彩虹眷村(レインボー ビラージュ) No. 25號春安路56巷 Chun'an Village, Nantun District, Taichung City, 台湾 408
catj: ヘリテージビルディング
2425.ed: Vibrant, colorful art painted on the remaining street & homes of a former veterans' village.
2425.edj: 兵役経験者の旧村の現存する通りと住宅に描かれた、鮮やかでカラフルなアート。

rv.t: Rainbow Village in Taichung is such a delightful and colorful experience! It fully deserves a 5-star rating. This tiny village has been transformed into a vibrant explosion of colors with adorable hand-painted murals covering almost every wall and even the ground. The cute cartoon characters, animals, and cheerful designs created by Grandpa Rainbow (Mr. Huang Yung-fu) are incredibly charming and make every corner…

I read somewhere that the village became much smaller compared how it used to be. But it is still a nice walk to see the colorful structure if you have the time. I came for a visit since it was on my way to the train station. Quite interesting and beautiful, not exactly something that I would go above and beyond to visit but it is worth a look. Good for a short break to view the graffiti and washroom break.

Very colourful place, worth visiting! One can take pretty pictures there :) Take note that it is quite far from the city center and other touristy places, however, is easy to reach from High Speed Rail train station. Be aware that it is popular with tourists. When I visited there were souvenir stands with cute magnets, keychains and similar things. One can also get a stamp there.

2426.a: Sakitsu Church, 539 Kawauramachi Sakitsu, Amakusa, Kumamoto 863-1204, Japan
2426.aj: 〒863-1204 熊本県天草市河浦町崎津５３９ カトリック﨑津教会
2426.ed: Visitors say this church features a unique Gothic architectural style with a rare tatami-mat interior, creating a beautiful blend of Japanese and Western aesthetics. They also highlight the serene and calming atmosphere, making it a peaceful place for reflection. Guests mention the convenient and free parking options available nearby.
2426.edj: キリシタン弾圧のための絵踏みが行われた吉田庄屋役宅跡に建てられたゴシック様式の教会。近隣に無料の観光駐車場あり。

rv.t: Though I am non religious, I paid a visit there to see the church infrastructure which has some stories behind. The place was quiet, and cherry bloosms are everywhere in late March 2025🌸☺️ Nice! But not a must go i would say.
Not worth to drive all the way just to see the church and the very tiny town.

Beautiful church with interesting history of the Catholics in Amakusa. The front is made of stone but the rest of the church is made of wood. You can enter the church to look around, but pictures are not allowed inside.

2427.a: Gaomei Wetlands, Meidi St, Qingshui District, Taichung City, Taiwan 436
2427.aj: 高美湿地 Meidi St, Qingshui District, Taichung City, 台湾 436
2427.ed: Natural wetlands park with walkways, offering scenic views of the water & sunsets.
2427.edj: 遊歩道のある自然の湿地帯を利用した公園。水辺や夕日の景色を楽しめる。

rv.t: One of the best sunset view in Taichung near beach but cannot swim only walk barefoot in a long open sand beach. Crowded as always so if you want to be in quiet place and watch sunset. You can in different places to watch it, outside also have food stalls to buy food and parking lot has payment if you park you motorcycle in the near restaurant or stores. The road is not yet finish repairing so be careful while…

A must see place when visiting this side of Taichung, after all you are here to see this amazing wetland. Come at the right time and it will reward you amazing view all around: the wetland itself, the row of wind turbines lined up in the distance, the sky meets the ocean, the mud skippers and crabs, the sun shines, and the wind blows. Wish there were less people around but eveyone was walking and enjoying themselves…

If you’re planning to visit Taichung, Gaomei Wetlands is one place you shouldn’t miss! 😍 When I arrived, the cool sea breeze and the sight of the giant wind turbines instantly gave me that peaceful, nature vibe. The wooden boardwalk stretches out into the wetlands, and walking there during sunset is just magical — the sky turns orange and pink, and you can see the reflection of the colors on the shallow water. ✨…

2428.a: Japan, 〒640-1114 Wakayama, Kaiso District, Kimino, Nakada, 生石高原
2428.aj: 〒640-1114 和歌山県海草郡紀美野町中田 生石高原
2428.ed: Highland plateau reached by hiking trail & known for views of seasonal Japanese pampas grass.
2428.edj: ハイキング コースを通って行く高原。季節になると花を咲かせるシロガネヨシで有名。

rv.t: Beautiful place and not much people
Beautiful and spectacular
Peacefully !!!

2429.a: Nakada Rice Terraces, Nakada, Kimino, Kaiso District, Wakayama 640-1114, Japan
2429.aj: 〒640-1114 和歌山県海草郡紀美野町中田中田の棚田

rv.t: ここに来るのは3回目です。昔は無かった「中田の棚田」の看板がありちょっと観光地っぽくなっていました。この風景が私は好きです。この先の180野上清水線の拡張工事がまだ終わってないようで長くかかっていますね。
スケールはそこそこ大きいも造形的にはイマイチ感で見晴らしそのものも何だか詰まらい感、何故に皆さん高評価なのか？解りません、アクセスも良くないし他のスポットからも離れてるので個人的にはわざわざ行く必要性は感じないです。
祝日のお昼に伺いました！ 曇りでしたが、霧掛かった山々の前の棚田がとても美しかったです！ 田んぼとしては使われていないように見えましたが、この規模の棚田はなかなかないのでとても感動しました！！ またいきたいです🙆🏻‍♂️

2430.a: Japan, 〒270-0128 Chiba, Nagareyama, Otakanomorinishi, 1-chome−15番1 【旧住所】 Spa Metsä Otaka, 西初石5丁目112
2430.aj: 〒270-0128 千葉県流山市おおたかの森西１丁目15番1 【旧住所】 スパメッツァおおたか 竜泉寺の湯 西初石5丁目112
2430.ed: People say this spa offers a wide variety of baths, including diverse carbonated springs and natural hot springs, alongside three types of saunas like the powerful "Dragon Sauna." They also highlight the clean facilities, convenient parking, and delicious food options. Other reviews mention the venue can be overly crowded.
2430.edj: クチコミによると、この温浴施設は、多様な炭酸泉や天然温泉を含む豊富な種類の浴槽と、「ドラゴンサウナ」のような強力なサウナを含む3種類のサウナが特徴で、高く評価されています。また、清潔な施設、便利な駐車場、美味しい食事も好評のようです。 一方で、施設が非常に混雑しているという意見も多く見られます。

rv.t: Amazing Onsen & sauna experience for the whole family ! There are to many features to list them all up 8 indoor pools, three outside, dry and steam saunas. Hot Stone & aroma saunas. Restaurant, detox bars, multiple relaxation areas including soft cushions, tents, capsels, huge reading corners, a terrace etc. Even tables, work desks, mini one man booths, and free flow detox waters for those who need to get work done…

Very big spa that is made with pretty low budget but is well maintained and clean despite the heavy use. The Ganban'yoku area saunas were not that great. The sento side was better but the saunas were too hot and this is why dry. But better than in many other Japanese saunas. I liked the salt scrub steam sauna and sento with very many options for bath temperature: the hottest was more than 43 degrees and the coldest…

Went here 3 months after it opened, just to see if my husband would still have the same opinion of it after he first went in May. His opinion is unchanged. I’m not a sauna junkie myself so my expectations were not set too high (I think). If you don’t look at the website you’ll find that the female side has three saunas 1. dry with auto loyly, aka their Dragon sauna (can seat around 20 people with social distancing)…

2431.a: Kosaku, 73-3 Isawacho Kubonakajima, Fuefuki, Yamanashi 406-0036, Japan
2431.aj: 〒406-0036 山梨県笛吹市石和町窪中島７３−３ 甲州ほうとう小作 石和駅前通り店
2431.ed: People say this restaurant offers a wide variety of delicious hoto noodles, including seasonal options, and other dishes like horse sashimi and tempura. They also highlight the generous portion sizes, the spacious and traditional tatami seating, and the friendly, attentive staff. Some reviews mention the service can be disorganized.
2431.edj: クチコミでは、このお店は季節限定のほうとうを含め、様々な種類の美味しいほうとうを提供しており、馬刺しや天ぷらなどの他の料理も楽しめることで知られています。また、ボリューム満点なこと、広々とした伝統的な畳の座席があること、そして親切で気配りの行き届いたスタッフも高く評価されています。 一部のクチコミでは、サービスがスムーズでない場合があるという意見もあります。

rv.t: Amazing place, really enjoyed the floor seating and tatami mats and the staff were absolutely wonderful. The fried chicken was delicious, but the spicy udon noodle soup lacked flavour (and spicyness). Still great food, and worth a visit, but the high standard of other places nearby makes it hard to give an honest 5 star. Would definitely come back! Fyi, i went at 4pm on a weekday and it was empty, so if youre…

This place was recommended to us by the manager of our guesthouse. We arrived at 7:30 PM and, despite the restaurant being quite large, it was completely full. We had to put our names on a waiting list and wait for a table. While waiting, you can already choose your dishes – menus are available outside the entrance. Around 8:00 PM, the crowd started to thin out noticeably. The service was efficient and friendly…

The atmosphere, service, and food are absolutely great! They had an English speaking staff which made everything easier. Theyre very helpful. There's a bit of wait before getting seated but the service is really fast. The tempura I had was the best tempura I've had in my life. They have big servings and their toilets are very clean. Definitely recommend this place if you're going to Yamanashi

2432.a: Yatsugatake Jomon Natural Hotspring Togariishi no Yu, 10246-1 Toyohira, Chino, Nagano 391-0213, Japan
2432.aj: 〒391-0213 長野県茅野市豊平１０２４６−１ 八ヶ岳縄文天然温泉 尖石の湯
2432.ed: Visitors say this hot spring offers a unique open-air bath experience with mineral-rich, green-tinged waters, and many appreciate the option to drink the spring water. They also highlight the tranquil, natural atmosphere and the availability of private indoor baths with showers. Some reviews mention there can be debris in the outdoor bath.
2432.edj: この温泉を訪れたユーザーのクチコミでは、ミネラルが豊富で緑がかった珍しい露天風呂の体験が高く評価されています。飲泉できる点も多くの人に喜ばれており、静かで自然豊かな雰囲気も魅力のようです。また、シャワー付きの貸し切り内風呂も利用できるという情報もあります。 一方で、露天風呂にはゴミが浮いていることがあるという声も聞かれます。

rv.t: Awesome onsen!!! So it’s all natural and there are special minerals in the water. You don’t bath before entering the water, no shower area. Instead use the the little buckets to rinse off before getting in the onsen. The grass walls are so cool. This is probably the coolest, most old fashioned onsen I’ve been to in Japan! 🥰
Mineral rich waters. Will be nice in fall/winter
Very beautyfull spot!

2432.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2433.a: Kusatsu Now Resort Hotel, 750 Kusatsu, Agatsuma District, Gunma 377-1711, Japan
2433.aj: 〒377-1711 群馬県吾妻郡草津町草津７５０ 草津ナウリゾートホテル
2433.ed: Relaxed quarters in an informal hot spring resort with indoor & outdoor bathing, plus 4 restaurants.
2433.edj: くつろいだ雰囲気の客室を備えた格式ばらない温泉リゾート。内湯と露天風呂、4 軒のレストランがある。

rv.t: Didn't stay at this hotel, but my partner and I were able to book a private hot spring for 75 minutes here, and I have to say, it was very romantic. We got into the bathtub with natural spring water, which was initially WAY too hot, but luckily, unlike the public onsens, we could adjust the temperature by adding cold water.

Good dinner buffet!||Seriously it was fantastic. You won’t get lots of sashimi or salmon roe or high end seafood, but you will get crab legs and very high quality Japanese food. Great variety. Very clean and renovated and large restaurant. Lots of people eating here. They even had a pianist and singer. ||I will say that I wish the floor of the outdoor onsen didn’t have its paint peeling off.||Location is right next…
We are Hong Kong tourists. It was the second times we stay in your hotel. Our family had a memorable and nice experience in your hotel.

2434.a: Nikon Museum, 株式会社ニコン 本社/イノベーションセンタ, 1F, 1 Chome-5-20 Nishioi, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 140-8601, Japan
2434.aj: 〒140-8601 東京都品川区西大井１丁目５−２０ 1F 株式会社ニコン 本社/イノベーションセンタ ニコンミュージアム
2434.ed: Intimate museum featuring exhibits on the history & technological uses of the Nikon camera.
2434.edj: ニコンの歴代製品と高度な活用法を紹介するこじんまりとした博物館。

rv.t: Hard to give less than 5 stars. Incredible collection of Nikon’s history, with free entry! Microscopes, telescopes, an astoundingly huge piece of glass, and a massive selection of cameras from every point in their history, including legends like their fisheyes and NASA editions. There’s also a Lawson in the lobby for a quick pre-visit snack.

It's lovely for anyone who loves cameras and understand the history of Nikon. Lots of camera and lenses on displays. There is a free tour (require online reservation) for those who are interested in the history and some facts about the brand. Certain interactive exhibits are actually quite fun and engaging to play with. There is also a gift store sells unique limited Nikon museum merch. Overall it's a nice place to…

The building is the HQ of Nikon. You go in the entrance, and then go around the main stairs on on the left, behind the stairs, is the museum. Admission is free. They tell you the engineering feats they made in lens and camera technology, and you see a huge collection of their microscopes, telescopes,wand of course their cameras. Really cool! You also get an idea of how the Shinagawa area developed economically too…

2434.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2435.a: Matsushima Shoreline, Matsushima, Miyagi District, Miyagi 981-0213, Japan
2435.aj: 〒981-0213 宮城県宮城郡松島町松島松島海岸
2435.ed: Visitors say this destination offers stunning views of numerous islands, which can be enjoyed from the shore or via a relaxing sightseeing cruise. They also highlight the variety of local gourmet food, including grilled oysters and sasakamaboko, available for enjoyable strolls. Others mention the area is compact, making it easy to explore attractions like Godaido Temple and Zuiganji Temple on…
2435.edj: この観光地を訪れた人は、海岸から、または遊覧船に乗って、たくさんの島々が織りなす素晴らしい景色を楽しめると評価しています。また、焼き牡蠣や笹かまぼこなど、地元の様々なグルメを散策しながら楽しめるという声もあります。五大堂や瑞巌寺といった観光スポットは、コンパクトなエリアにまとまっており、徒歩で巡りやすいという意見も聞かれます。

rv.t: One of the most famous sceneries in Japan. It is easy to reach, just take JR at Sendai to Matsushimankaigan Station. Lots of beautiful spots for photo shooting. You can also go to the small island 雄島. You can also try the famous Sendai ox tongues.

One of the Three Scenic Views of Japan. Compared with the Mediterranean around Sardinia in Italy, this “three views” spot feels more like a box-ticking destination if there’s no snow. Without snow or autumn foliage, it’s honestly quite disappointing. The boat is large and crowded with people. As for the onboard commentary, the ground portion really should just stay in Japanese—I ended up listening to the Japanese…

A beautiful shore and a nice view at every season. Went there in autumn and now in winter. To get to the Island Fukurajima via the red bridge you pay a fee of 200¥. The island is like a national park for the animals. So I think it’s absolutely ok to pay this small amount. I would love to come a again maybe in spring. From Sendai you reach it easily by train. Very convenient.

2436.a: Japan, 〒151-0063 Tokyo, Shibuya, Tomigaya, 2 Chome−22−12 THE COFFEESHOP
2436.aj: 〒151-0063 東京都渋谷区富ケ谷２丁目２２−１２ THE COFFEESHOP
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2436.ed: People say this cafe offers a wide variety of specialty coffee, with options for hand drip and AeroPress brewing methods. Visitors also highlight the reasonable prices and the sleek, peaceful atmosphere. They also mention the staff are friendly and helpful.
2436.edj: こじんまりとした珈琲販売店内にカフェスペースを完備。自家焙煎された豆で作るスペシャリティコーヒーが味わえる。

rv.t: was recommended this spot by a cafe owner in Tasmania, Australia. I love that it’s tucked away in a quieter neighborhood of Shibuya. You’ll need a bus from the main station to get here The cafe is sleek and peaceful, offering a great selection of beans. I opted for the tasting flight, which was 1,600 Yen for three coffees (including one premium choice)—an incredible deal for Tokyo! My absolute favorite was the…
So, no roasting machine here anymore Buut still great vibe and super nice people w perfect cappuccino w cutie ceramic cup I believe the owner has greaaaat sense and style! Sly!

Amazing coffee and nice staff. Limited places to sit but as I just stopped in before a meeting it was a great spot to be able to grab an excellent cold brew and get some work done. Thanks and will be back.

2437.a: IRON COFFEE, 1 Chome-18-9 Gotokuji, Setagaya City, Tokyo 154-0021, Japan
2437.aj: 〒154-0021 東京都世田谷区豪徳寺１丁目１８−９ IRON COFFEE

2437.ed: People say this coffee shop offers delicious coffee, including smooth lattes, flavorful pour-overs, and excellent cold brew, with a wide selection of high-quality beans. They also highlight the friendly and welcoming staff, who often provide helpful local recommendations. Visitors appreciate the reasonable prices and the cozy, inviting atmosphere.
2437.edj: このコーヒーショップを利用した人からは、なめらかなラテ、風味豊かなハンドドリップコーヒー、素晴らしいコールドブリューなど、高品質な豆を幅広く取り揃えており、コーヒーが美味しいというクチコミが多くあります。また、親しみやすく親切なスタッフが、地元の美味しいお店を教えてくれることも高く評価されています。手頃な価格と居心地の良い雰囲気も、訪れた人々に喜ばれています。

rv.t: This was my first time visiting this coffee bar, and it was truly a wonderful experience. The coffee was incredible, beautifully balanced, carefully prepared, and full of character. You can really taste the passion and intention behind every cup. Yuki was incredibly kind and welcoming. We had such a nice conversation and felt genuinely cared for the entire time. It didn’t feel like just having coffee, it felt like…

Amazing small coffee shop on your way to Gōtokuji Temple. We stopped there during the morning and there was a lovely barista on shift. She was so kind and attentive. We chat a bit about her upcoming plans for visiting Mexico! I went for an iced drip coffee which was well balanced. The price was on the affordable side, which was amazing considering the coffee quality. Highly recommend!

When get off the train and heading to Gotokuji, find this coffee shop. The young staff is so nice. He introduces each available hand drip coffee beans in details, and ask the taste I like for giving me recommendation. Finally selected Ethiopia beans. And it already giving good smell when he start the dripping. The taste is so good. Really make me a good start of the day ^.^ During the preparation, he also introduced…

2438.a: Japan, 〒154-0023 Tokyo, Setagaya City, Wakabayashi, 4 Chome−22−18 パトリア松蔭 iri coffee roastery
2438.aj: 〒154-0023 東京都世田谷区若林４丁目２２−１８ パトリア松蔭 iri coffee roastery
2438.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious, deeply flavored hand-drip coffee and tasty limited-edition egg sandwiches. They also highlight the cozy, relaxing atmosphere and the friendly, attentive staff.
2438.edj: このカフェを利用した人からは、深く味わいのあるハンドドリップコーヒーと、美味しい期間限定の卵サンドが高く評価されています。また、居心地の良い落ち着いた雰囲気と、親切で丁寧なスタッフの対応も評判のようです。

rv.t: Came to the area for a pop up shop and got hungry. It was the perfect light lunch/coffee break! Coffee was delicious, and the hot sandwiches are nice and toasty. Food order seems to come with a side of coffee jelly, which was properly bitter and I absolutely loved it. What a little gem—I wish I lived nearby!
Very pretty inside and outside. Great coffee with a variety of blends. In a quiet are so also a very relaxing atmosphere. I can recommend the egg sando.

I can tell a lot of effort is put into the shop here. Good coffee with lots of intention and flavour. There are charging outlets, but no wifi. Very clean establishment. Bathroom was impeccably spotless! English menu available. FYI - I would absolutely not recommend this place if you need to do work on your laptop. This is not the kind of coffee shop for this. I was desperate to finish work and this shop opened early…

2439.a: Maruya, 8 Chome-16-8 Kitami, Setagaya City, Tokyo 157-0067, Japan
2439.aj: 〒157-0067 東京都世田谷区喜多見８丁目１６−８ 丸屋
2439.ed: Diners like this restaurant's authentic soba and udon, noting the noodles have a firm texture and a pleasant mouthfeel. They also highlight the wide variety of delicious tempura, including crispy fried kombu, and the generous portion sizes. Guests mention the reasonable prices and the cozy, old-fashioned atmosphere.
2439.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、本格的なそばとうどんを高く評価しており、麺はしっかりとしたコシがあり、のど越しが良いというクチコミが多くあります。また、サクサクに揚がった昆布の天ぷらをはじめ、種類豊富な美味しい天ぷらも好評で、ボリューム満点な点も評価されています。手頃な価格と、居心地の良い昔ながらの雰囲気を気に入ったという声もあります。

rv.t: Amazing place to get authentic Soba & Udon in a nicer quaint atmosphere. I like seaweed but don't really eat much deep-fried food, but the deep-fried Kombu is definitely a must if you've never had it!

We ordered to the house straight from the shop and the food came surprisingly quick! The food got here hot and in nice dishes. I had the katsudon with hot udon. The katsudon was very delicious and the portion was large. The udon was delicious as well. I am definitely going to order from here again in the near future. Very great meal and the delivery’s service was exceptional.
The soba texture was fantastic and the portion was big :) There was also warm drink outside the restaurant for customers who were queuing.

rv.t: they serve about 5 different type of soba and I can choose one Mar-21
Great discovery, if you want to taste an incredible soba restaurant, this is the one. I would recommend the 5 soba flavors
Delicious soba made without any fillers.

rv.t: Nice quaint yarn shop. Seasonal yarns so a lot of wool and cashmere due to colder weather. Helpful staff who helped me find enough yarn for my projects. But they also offer trimmings yarn and cottom/acrylic yarns for more utilitarian ueses. Everyone was kind and nice. Will come back again.
It was our first time in Tokyo and we found this yarn shop full of the cutest yarn, so nice and cozy. I bought 2 skeins and now I really need more. How can I order more from USA? 🙏 🙏 ❤️
the cutest yarn store featuring lots of 25g skeins. love the labelling!! staff are so sweet

rv.t: The lady that runs this place is lovely. Great selection of books, including children's books and a few English ones. I bought a couple of presents for friends back home.
I've been thinking about this place off and on all day since I went this morning. The selection and flavours and AMAZING! Sweet and savoury baked goods of every kind! Plus, lovely drink options.
A great place to work, connect with friends or just read a book. Wide selection of sweet and savoury pastries and snacks.

rv.t: We had breakfast at Higurashi Garden, and it was honestly one of the breakfast highlights of our trip. The pastries we tried were outstanding—fresh and flavourful, and clearly made with so much care. The matcha and coffee were both delicious and the perfect way to start our morning. We also noticed (and agree with others) that the quality of the ingredients really stands out, and everything is beautifully presented…

This bakery offers a variety of sweet and savoury pastries, like croissants, cinnamon rolls, tarts, quiche, sandwiches, curry buns, doughnuts... The ambience is cozy and inviting with many seating options, including 2…

Very good (and popular!) bakery and bookshop with communal feel, plenty of space to seat, both indoor and in the coutyard, and delicious bakes! The bookstore keeper is such a lovely lady, she absolutely made my day! If you are a fan of Chiaki Ida's artwork, don't miss the special colab event taking place there this month (May)!!!

2444.a: Farm Yokota Cafe, 1 Chome-11-10 Toneri, Adachi City, Tokyo 121-0831, Japan
2444.aj: 〒121-0831 東京都足立区舎人１丁目１１−１０ ファーム ヨコタ cafe
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2444.ed: Diners like this cafe's healthy, home-style daily lunch sets, which feature a variety of small dishes and a main, and appreciate the quick service. They also highlight the tranquil, green terrace seating and reasonable prices. Some reviews mention the atmosphere can be less spacious.
2444.edj: ログハウス風のカジュアルな店内で、朝はモーニングセット、昼はカレーやナポリタンを提供している。駐車場完備。

rv.t: I had pork cutlet, and it was outstanding. The sides and the main were all very succulent and full of flavor. Always pleased with the atmosphere and the food. Everyone is very friendly and pleasant.
Lovely quiet cafe. Cozy. Food was nice and the toilet seat opens all by itself!
今まで食べたコロッケの中で1番美味しかった。かぼちゃの煮物もほろほろ。緑に囲まれながら、体にいいものを食べてる感じが良い。蚊取り線香をたくさん炊いてくれるので、テラスでも蚊に刺されずに済んだ。デザートも美味しそうだった。

2445.a: Jōmon natural onsen - Shiraku no yu, 4 Chome-314-1 Tsukagoshi, Saiwai Ward, Kawasaki, Kanagawa 212-0024, Japan
2445.aj: 〒212-0024 神奈川県川崎市幸区塚越４丁目３１４−１ 縄文天然温泉 志楽の湯
2445.ed: Natural hot spring with a rustic, old-fashioned feel, offering indoor & outdoor pools & saunas.
2445.edj: 古民家風の天然温泉施設や蕎麦屋を併設する研修施設。縄文人をテーマにした館内は温かみある雰囲気。コンパクトな1人用客室を中心に用意。

rv.t: On a long layover at Haneda I really was craving a dip in an outdoor onsen, after being on the road from Thailand for 2 full days. Fatigued and sore from sitting on ferries, buses, and airplanes, I wanted to relax in an onsen and feel myself again. I found this on Google just looking at the photos and took the train to find out. And Omg I am so happy I did. One of those moments I'm so glad I was born Japanese. Lol…

Really cute rustic day-use onsen. The facility isn’t super sparkling clean, but it has a really nice vibe and the deep yellow onsen water is great. The outdoor bath was really hot (~42C, nice!) and the sauna was great too (~100C, nice!). The staff was very friendly. Accessibility to people who don’t speak Japanese is probably alright, the most important sign pointing to the male/female bathing areas was translated…

Extremely friendly to me as a foreigner, despite everyone else being locals. Very friendly staff, great baths. If you're concerned about the nudity, don't let that stop you from enjoying this great pleasure.

2446.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious soba noodles, crispy tempura, and traditional Japanese sweets like kuzumochi. They also highlight the calm atmosphere, attentive staff, and pet-friendly seating options. Some reviews mention the soba can be inconsistent.
2446.edj: 天ぷらや一品料理も提供する古民家風のそば屋。ペット連れでも利用できる縁側席や座敷席を備える。甘味やコーヒーも用意する。全席禁煙。

rv.t: I came on a rainy day and got what I think was probably the best seat in the restaurant. The restaurant was packed with mostly locals, which I think is a good sign that the restaurant is good. I ordered gomadare soba (sesame soba) with kuzumochi. They give you sobayu on the side with the soba, which is the water the noodles were cooked with. You’re supposed to add it to your leftover broth after your done eating and…

Walking by the temple near by, I found a nice and quiet Soba noodle shop with a lovely garden area out front. I had to enter to try and was glad I did as the environment was quite relaxing and the food was fresh and tasty. I would recommend trying the soba with mochi set!
Superb soba in a Tranquil location. Well worth seeking out. Light and crispy tempura. Divine kuzomochi. Very reasonable price.

rv.t: I'm a big fan of Chinmaya. The first time I know about Chi, Maya is the one at Kamiyacho. After that near Nihonbashi and hatsudai. And the one at sangenjaya head closed due to fire accident. This one is quite tasty and more variety menu.
The food is decent the service is friendly. However it's a little crammed and hot.

▶︎『陳麻家 五反田さくら通り店』 こちらは都内を中心に展開している、担々麺と陳麻飯を看板にしたお店。 辛旨系のご飯ものを手早く食べたい時に便利な一軒です✨ 今回は平日の昼間に同僚4人で訪問しました♪ 場所は五反田駅から徒歩4分ほど。 お店はさくら通り沿いにあり、入口の階段を下りて入るつくりです。 店内はカジュアルに入れる雰囲気で、テーブル席のみの構成でした◎ 今回いただいたもの⬇️ ▪️チンマーハン 990円 一般的な麻婆豆腐より粘度感があるのが印象。 とろみのある餡に辛味とコクがしっかりありつつも、単調じゃない味わいでご飯がどんどん進むタイプでした♪ 卓上の山椒をかけるとキリッとした風味が加わり、もともとの旨みにもう一段奥行きが出ます✨ ボリュームもしっかりあるので、ランチでも夜でも満足感は十分◎ スープも一緒に付いてくるのも嬉しいポイントです。 辛旨系のご飯ものをサクッと食べたい時には、候補に入れやすい一品だと思います！…

2448.a: Koishikawa Korakuen Gardens, 1 Chome-6-6 Koraku, Bunkyo City, Tokyo 112-0004, Japan
2448.aj: 〒112-0004 東京都文京区後楽１丁目６−６ 小石川後楽園

2448.edj: 歩道、池、橋がある 17 世紀までさかのぼる静かで美しい庭園。

rv.t: Beautiful park/garden with lots of history and sights including a small rice field planted by a historical noble for his family to tend to. We walked through this park before catching a game at the Dome and it was a pleasant surprise winding through the green paths and along the creeks.

Beautiful traditional Japanese garden located next to the Tokyo Dome. Koishikawa Korakuen is relatively small but very well maintained and peaceful. Walking paths circle around a central pond, with bridges, trees, and carefully designed landscapes typical of classic Japanese strolling gardens. The garden dates back to the early Edo period in the 17th century and is considered one of the oldest gardens in Tokyo…

Always a favorite garden in any season. We were here a bit early for full color this autumn, and it was still as lovely as ever. If you can, try to visit on a weekday for less crowded experience. I have been here probably ten plus times but it never gets old. Visit the plum grove in spring!!

rv.t: Akha Ama Coffee Kagurazaka is one of my favorite specialty cafes in Shinjuku, Japan ☕️🇯🇵 The baked goods and food looked insane as well! This is a unique café that directly supports tribal farmers in Northern Thailand by serving their sustainably grown, smooth coffee featuring notes of rich chocolate and natural sweetness across its five global branches. ✅️ Please follow @bouncingplaces on YOUTUBE It helps support…

Delicious latte served in a warm & welcoming environment. Staff is friendly and takes great pride in both the coffee quality & appearance of shop. The only place we visited twice during our trip. Highly recommend.

We went back 4 days in a row, the combination of gluten-free scones, the latte art, killer sandwiches, a robust pumpkin quiche, and the creamiest hot chocolate as well as the early opening hour made it a hit with all four family members.

Worth to visit!! The taste and portion of food are just right. Free refill for rice (in the set menu), salad, pickles and egg. The menu also various and interesting. The staff interaction and service also good. The place quite big and not so many people (around 14.00)
The Xiao long Bao skin was too thick. Sweet and sour pork was sweet but mostly flour. It's alright japanese chi food

2452.a: Kashikojima Hojoen, 718-3 Agocho Shinmei, Shima, Mie 517-0502, Japan
2452.aj: 〒517-0502 三重県志摩市阿児町神明７１８−３ 賢島宝生苑

A relaxing stay with excellent hot springs—especially the outdoor bath with lovely views. The dinner was also very good, with fresh seafood and a satisfying Japanese dining experience.

After staying at many other ryokans and receiving warm and personalized service, we found this place to be very large and quite impersonal. The dining experience has more of a cafeteria vibe - even though a kaiseki meal is being served. The server comes in with each course and and provides a quick description in Japanese and immediately exits. The printed menu is also only in Japanese and no effort is made to…

2453.a: Kurashiki Bikan Historical Quarter, 4 Central, Kurashiki, Okayama 710-0046, Japan
2453.aj: 〒710-0046 岡山県倉敷市中央４ 倉敷美観地区
2453.ed: Historic area with classic architecture situated along a canal, with shops, eateries & galleries.
2453.edj: 運河沿いに古い建築物が立ち並ぶ歴史地区。店舗、飲食店、ギャラリーが点在する。

rv.t: We visited Kurashiki Bikan District and really enjoyed the beautiful scenery. The old Japanese houses, traditional streets, and calm riverside atmosphere made the whole place feel peaceful. We took a lot of photos and loved experiencing Japan's history and culture up close. In the evening, there was a Natsu Matsuri event, and it made the trip even better. We enjoyed watching the parades, dancers from different…

This district is absolutely magnificent and definitely underrated. You must come here, if only for the incredible and peaceful atmosphere. It is very easy to access by taking the train from the surrounding mid-sized cities. It’s a perfect place to wander along the canals and enjoy the historic architecture. A must-see!

Beautiful old school vibes. The location is quite busy so if you want come good photos should come earlier. Didn’t eat here so not too sure how the restaurant are. Just plan half a day here… should’ve more than enough. Apparently they are popular for denim wear or products, but most are just central production and everyone is selling same stuff. Be ware or what you are buying

2454.a: Satoyama Transit, スカイプラザ・モール 2階 4 Chome-1-1 Yukarigaoka, Sakura, Chiba 285-0858, Japan
2454.aj: 〒285-0858 千葉県佐倉市ユーカリが丘４丁目１−１ スカイプラザ・モール 2階 里山トランジット
catj: 日本式洋食レストラン
ファミリー レストラン
2454.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious dishes, especially the fresh local vegetables, creative cuisine, and seasonal offerings. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, along with the pleasant atmosphere. Some reviews mention reservations can be unacknowledged.
2454.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーは、美味しい料理、特に新鮮な地元野菜を使った独創的な料理や季節限定のメニューを高く評価しています。また、親しみやすく気の利くスタッフと心地よい雰囲気も好評のようです。 一部のクチコミでは、予約が確認されていないという意見もあります。

rv.t: Such a surprisingly beautiful spot. Panoramic windows overlook the town. Gives it a bright, cheerful, upscale feel. Reservations are recommended - it was packed - but they accommodated our large walk-in group because they happened to have one large private room available (seats 10-12...maybe more?) Counter bar-style seating also available as well as booths and regular tables. Menu had a couple of offerings from 'Top…

Great restaurant with nice view and big choice of Japanese shochu. Food is also great, stuff is super friendly. If you occasionally came to this part of Japan, this place is a best to spend an evening. Will come back for sure. Left piece of my heart there.
We visit here frequently for lunch and it is excellent. Very reasonably priced and very child friendly! Delicious karaage.

2455.a: Cafe Casa, 3 Chome-41-1 Jingumae, Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0001, Japan
2455.aj: 〒150-0001 東京都渋谷区神宮前３丁目４１−１ カフェ香咲
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2455.ed: Cozy cafe with a charming country-garden feel, serving pasta dishes, curries & dessert, plus coffee.
2455.edj: 可愛らしいカントリー ガーデン風の居心地の良いカフェ。パスタ、カレー、デザート、コーヒーを楽しめる。

rv.t: This is a cute mom and pop type place with a resident dog. I really enjoyed the food here, and visited a second time for lunch with my 5 year old. She wouldn't have been able to finish an entire portion, so we had planned to share. There is a one order per person policy, which is quite common in Tokyo. However, none of the drinks were appropriate for a small child and would have cost not that much less than a lunch…

Coffee tastes OK, a bit expensive (starting around 800 yen). But they potentially charged us for sold-out items which we didn’t have. Also, the shop tried to delete the comment from the Japanese review platform even we have four witnesses (We are foreign tourists but 2 of us understand Japanese). It’s a cash-only shop that we order food with the servant. Two items we tried to order were sold out already told by the…

This was a wonderful lunch find! My husband and I got seated at the counter and had the most amazing conversation with the couple the owns the cafe. If you’re looking for a place that feels like home, this is it! We will 1000% be coming back!

2456.a: Tsukechi Gorge, 6-39 Tsukechicho, Nakatsugawa, Gifu 508-0351, Japan
2456.aj: 〒508-0351 岐阜県中津川市付知町６−３９ 付知峡
2456.ed: Steep-sided ravine famed for its autumn colors, with a hiking trail, waterfalls & suspension bridge.
2456.edj: 紅葉で有名な断崖絶壁の渓谷。ハイキング コース、滝、吊り橋がある。

rv.t: Tsukechi Gorge in winter is beautiful, with stunning snowy scenery, frozen waterfalls, and really peaceful surroundings. Some parts of the trail can be a little slippery, but the views are definitely worth it, just wear proper shoes. Highlight of the trip was meeting Felicia the Snow Lady, the gorge’s most glamorous seasonal tourist attraction. She was serving full diva energy and clearly stealing the spotlight from…
Powerful water streams in a lovely natural setting. Enjoyed a nice walk through well maintained path. 200 yen suggested donation and free parking.
Pretty but a little manufactured. Restaurant had a noodle sluice that you capture and eat, looked fun but we didn’t realise till after we ordered different dishes.

2457.a: Onigajo Rock Formations, 1835-7 Kinomotocho, Kumano, Mie 519-4323, Japan
2457.aj: 〒519-4323 三重県熊野市木本町１８３５−７ 鬼ヶ城
2457.ed: World Heritage–listed coastline with 0.7 mi. of unusual rock formations, cliffs & a visitor center.
2457.edj: ユネスコ世界遺産に登録されている海岸の景勝地。珍しい形状の岩や岸壁が 1.1 km 続く。ビジター センターあり。

rv.t: The first thing I felt when I arrived at Onigajo Rock was the incredible power and grandeur of nature. Standing before these massive rock formations, I couldn’t help but wonder how thousands of years of waves, wind, and time had shaped them into such a breathtaking masterpiece. Every cliff, every cave, and every layer of rock tells a story that has been written by nature itself. Walking along the coastal paths…

This national treasure is a must visit when traveling down the coast of the Mie prefecture. Be careful when hiking the cliff side as the rails aren't completely safe, recommended to bring gloves as the railing could be severely corroded due to the salt water, and when the weather is wet, wear hiking boots. We hike about 1/2 way and turned back due the high winds that were blowing after passing the crest of the…

A great place to go for a lovely coastal walk along the cliffs. The water here is beautiful and the cliffs are amazing. You can really get a sense of the power of nature by looking at all the erosion and the bent hand rails from the power of the waves. I recommend walking fully to the end and back to experience the whole walk. There is plenty of free parking at the local visitors centre and they sell drinks and…

2458.a: Tokoname Pottery Footpath, Sakaemachi, Tokoname, Aichi 479-0836, Japan
2458.aj: 〒479-0836 愛知県常滑市栄町やきもの散歩道
2458.ed: Remains of a Showa-era pottery village, including chimneys & kilns, plus ceramics shops & galleries.
2458.edj: 煙突や窯など、昭和時代の焼き物の里の風情が残る散歩道。陶磁器店とギャラリーがある。

rv.t: I spent a relaxing afternoon here, learning the history of this area, it was one of the six ancient kiln centers in Japan. However, they mainly produced industrial products, not very artistic. There are some pottery workshops/shopd there, but the products were not very high quality. Some ceramic shops also double up as cafe. Half day trip shoikd be enough.

small street famous by IG may be history too ,the walk is through jp houses and lot of cafes with various pottery food drinks and jp specials,good and relaxing,mochi pounding mochi ice cream also available in the way,found indian tea selling by corner.this way leads to Cat statue too.
Nice scenic walk with lots of pottery workshops and cafes, you can choose from 3 routes of different distance and difficulty. The shortest route will take approximately 1 hr to complete.

2459.a: Yokoyama View Point, 875-20 Agocho Ugata, Shima, Mie 517-0501, Japan
2459.aj: 〒517-0501 三重県志摩市阿児町鵜方８７５−２０ 横山展望台
2459.ed: Wooden mountainside viewing terrace with national park & bay panoramas & a café.
2459.edj: 横山に設けられた木製の展望テラス。国立公園や英虞湾のパノラマビューが楽しめる。カフェを併設。

rv.t: Nice hiking trails that offer some incredible views. Trails were well-designed so you can do short hikes to the key observation points or stitch them together for a longer hike. The cafe offers nice treats and good coffee. Don’t forget to stop by the Tourist Info center at Ugata Station right outside the ticket gate on 2F. You can get a special round trip taxi coupon -¥1,000 each way and they will even arrange a…

Yokoyama View Point (横山展望台) is a renowned observation deck in Shima, Mie Prefecture, offering panoramic views of the indented Ago Bay, featuring pearl islands, and popular Ise-Shima National Park. It features a modern wooden Tenku Cafe Terrace and walking trails. The main viewpoint sits at an altitude of 140 meters, providing breathtaking vistas of the sea and scattered islands. Several trails connect to other…

You can enjoy a panoramic view of the spectacular Ago Bay, one of the highlights of Ise-Shima National Park. The observation deck features a spacious terrace, making it an ideal spot for taking commemorative photos. The scenery of Ago Bay, dotted with numerous small islands, is truly unique, with a strikingly beautiful contrast between lush greenery and deep blue waters. There is also a rest area with a café where…
